d: Long, flowing pastel pink hair is styled into a high ponytail with blunt-cut bangs and a side-parted strand held by a small black clip. The eyes are a vivid magenta with a wide, cheerful expression, set on a youthful face of a teenager. A slender build is dressed in a white off-the-shoulder blouse with ruffled sleeves, a black bow at the chest, a dark brown pleated mini-skirt with gold trim, and asymmetrical black stockings. Signature details include black animal ears, a black choker, a small red utility pouch on a belt, and a large circular saw-blade weapon.
